dog.description_text:
Wildflower is a Great Pyrenees mix puppy who is expected to be medium-sized when fully grown, and she’s the kind of girl who just needs a little time before showing you how sweet she really is. She can be shy and fearful at first, so patience goes a long way. Having another dog around helps even more, because Wildflower absolutely loves canine companionship and takes a lot of confidence from her dog friends.

Once she starts feeling comfortable, you get to meet the real Wildflower: sweet, kind, energetic, and very into cuddles. She loves other dogs, loves affection from her people, and has that puppy enthusiasm that makes everything a little more fun. She’ll do best with adopters who are happy to let her warm up at her own pace and help her keep building confidence as she grows.

Registered adopters interested in Wildflower can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
